title: Stoat
summary: STOAT, noun An animal of the weasel king; the ermine. This animal is called stoat when of a reddish color, and ermine when white, as in winter.

inlines.v: STOAT, noun An animal of the weasel king; the ermine. This animal is called stoat when of a reddish color, and ermine when white, as in winter.
